liveProofs.purpose: Verify real Access application and no bypass path
Verify trusted team issuer and exact application audience
Verify trusted provider public keys, rotation and network failure
Verify actual Access logout/revocation behavior; sid is NOT guaranteed
Verify account-to-opaque-subject binding, NICK is display only
Verify independent server-issued assessment policy and scope
Verify separate staging Worker and empty staging D1
Verify nonproduction backup and rollback readiness
Verify EN/ES/PT and portrait/landscape/desktop with real browsers
Verify deny matrix from outside Access plus no-store
Obtain explicit staging-only release approval after audit

phases.description: Connect a user-authorized read-only browser session to Cloudflare dashboard; inspect only
Identify actual team domain and Access application, verify protected hostname; save no secrets
Verify no active production database or hostname is used for experiments
Choose real Access revocation behavior; no fabricated sid claim
Prepare separate staging Worker/D1 and rollback plan for independent approval
Only after independent evidence and explicit approval consider any remote deployment
